subject: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 status & compliance roadmap (FinCo)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Liu <david.liu@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 status & compliance roadmap (FinCo)

Hi David —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Great to learn more about FinCo's security and procurement checklist. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Current status (from our conversation): you’re evaluating vendors for a new LLM-powered assistant and security/compliance is the gating factor.
- Items you asked for:
  1) SOC 2 status and scope details
  2) Confirmation on GDPR data processing and any HIPAA considerations
  3) Vendor security questionnaire initiation (we can fill or provide evidence)
  4) High-level roadmap for additional certifications (ISO 27001 / FedRAMP)

Action items / next steps: 
- I attached a short Redwood compliance roadmap (redwood-compliance-roadmap-2026.pdf) and a SOC 2 one-pager for quick review.
- Please share FinCo's vendor security questionnaire — we can start populating answers and return evidence artifacts.
- Proposed follow-up: 30 min technical/compliance sync w/ your security lead + our Head of Security (Rishi). Are you available next week (Dec 21/22) for a quick call?

If helpful I can also outline which controls are typically in-scope for our SOC 2 Type II (data encryption, access controls, change management, monitoring).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: redwood-compliance-roadmap-2026.pdf (summary), SOC2-one-pager.pdf (summary)

From: David Liu <david.liu@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finco.com
Date: 2026-12-16T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 status & compliance roadmap (FinCo)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap. A few clarifying items from our team: 

- Current FinCo position: procurement requires a completed vendor security questionnaire + SOC 2 Type II (or Type I with roadmap to Type II) for any vendor with access to customer data.
- GDPR: we need confirmation of data processing/transfer controls and standard DPAs.
- HIPAA: not required across the platform today, but a subset of customers may require covered workflows — want to understand any PHI handling restrictions.

I attached our vendor security questionnaire (FinCo_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf). Please confirm who on your side will be the point of contact to complete it and what evidence artifacts you can provide (policy docs, SOC 2 report, penetration test summary, encryption details).

Two quick questions you can answer now: 
1) Do you currently have a SOC 2 Type II report? If not, what is your target date?
2) Do you have regional data residency options (US/EU)?

If we can get preliminary answers by EOD Monday, we’ll expedite procurement review.

—
David Liu
Director, Vendor Security & Compliance
FinCo
david.liu@finco.com

Attachment: FinCo_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Liu <david.liu@finco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-17T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 status & compliance roadmap (FinCo)

David —

Thanks for the file and the questions. Below are concise answers and a proposed plan to get your procurement team what they need quickly.

Answers: 
- SOC 2: Redwood currently has a SOC 2 Type I report (completed 2026-06) and we have an active program to achieve SOC 2 Type II. Target for Type II report: Q1 2027 (March target for audit period coverage). We can share the Type I report and interim controls evidence now.
- Data residency: We offer region-based hosting options (US and EU regions) and can discuss contractually scoped residency for customer data.
- HIPAA: We support covered use-cases via our Private/On-prem options; we do not process PHI in the hosted tier by default unless under a BAA and configured controls.

Proposed plan to move procurement forward: 
1) We will start populating FinCo_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.pdf and return a completed draft by 2026-12-20. (Point of contact on our side: me — marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com).
2) Rishi (cc’d) will provide technical/controls artifacts (pen test summary, encryption at-rest/in-transit detail, IAM controls). Expect another email with attachments and links to evidence.
3) We will share our SOC 2 Type I report and the compliance roadmap (attached / drive link) for review.

Proposed next call: 30 min on 2026-12-21 or 2026-12-22 to walk through the questionnaire and alignment on timeline. What time window works best for you / your security lead?

> - GDPR: we need confirmation of data processing/transfer controls and standard DPAs.
> - HIPAA: not required across the platform today, but a subset of customers may require covered workflows — want to understand any PHI handling restrictions.

Thanks — we’ll aim to get the draft questionnaire back to you by Monday.

Date: 2026-12-20T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 status & compliance roadmap (FinCo)

David / Marissa —

Following up with a few technical notes for FinCo’s security team: 

- SOC 2 roadmap: we are planning scope expansion during the Type II engagement to include dedicated control coverage around data segregation, key management, and change management for serving runtime.
- ISO 27001: roadmap milestone for evaluation in H2 2027 (if FinCo needs ISO sooner we can discuss prioritization).
- FedRAMP: we are exploring marketplace options and can discuss a FedRAMP-aligned architecture for Dedicated/Private deployments; this is longer-term (2027+), but we can provide an architecture brief.

I’ve uploaded a short compliance artifacts bundle to the drive link Marissa shared and will attach a pen test summary and our encryption whitepaper in a follow-up email.

Happy to join the call on 2026-12-21 — Marissa, David: please confirm a time and I’ll make sure the technical artifacts are available.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
